title: Expertise (passive feature)
html:
See also: Blessings of Knowledge

 Expertise is a passive feature that allows a character to double their Proficiency bonus on Skills.

Description

Choose two Skills you are Proficient in. Your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for any Ability Check you make that uses either Skill.
